story: I missed my bus by seconds this morning and was honestly annoyed. Then I noticed a tiny dog sitting beside the next stop, wearing a little yellow sweater. I forgot about the bus completely and started laughing. Somehow, missing that bus made my morning better.

character_bible.main_character: Young man, mid-20s, short dark hair, navy blue jacket, dark trousers, white sneakers
character_bible.dog: Tiny brown dog, floppy ears, yellow knitted sweater
